summary: Dedicated readiness dashboard: template variables not populating for newly-created pool IDs
description:
Issue summary
- Grafana dashboard variables (Pool ID / Customer / Region) on the Dedicated Readiness dashboard are not populating for newly-created Dedicated pools.
- Impact: operators cannot filter/drill down by the new pool IDs during provisioning pilot; dashboard appears empty unless hardcoding IDs into panel queries.

Impact
- During staging/prod pilot runs, on-call and Infra have to hunt metrics manually (explore/log search) instead of using the standard readiness dashboard.
- This is blocking validation of time-to-ready stage breakdowns for new pools and makes alerts harder to triage.

Observed behavior
- Dashboard loads, but template variables show "No options" (Pool ID) and panels that depend on $pool_id show no data.
- Older pool IDs still appear, and panels render if using a known older pool_id.

Expected behavior
- Newly-created pool IDs (e.g., created by fleet provisioner in the last 24h) should appear in the template variable dropdowns and drive the panels/links.

Scope / notes
- This appears to be a dashboard templating/query issue rather than missing telemetry: metrics exist when queried directly by label.

Steps to reproduce
1) Open Grafana: Dedicated Readiness Dashboard (prod)
2) Open variable dropdown: Pool ID
3) Observe "No options" for a newly-created pool (created via the provision-to-ready pipeline)
4) In Explore, run a direct query for the metric used by a panel (e.g., time-to-ready histogram) with pool_id label set to the new pool ID; data exists

Suspected root cause
- The variable query is based on a regex/label_values() over a metric that no longer includes new pools (or is filtered by a label key that changed for the new pipeline).
- New pool IDs appear to be emitted as pool_uuid (or pool) label, while the variable query expects pool_id.
- Additional possibility: Grafana variable query is pointed at the wrong datasource / wrong Prometheus tenant for the new provisioning metrics.

Supporting evidence
- Slack thread discussing variable vs label naming and dashboard validation: #eng-sre (ref: 1709221777)

Request
- Observability to update the dashboard templates/variables to support the new pool identifier label(s) produced by the provisioning pipeline.
- If we need to support both old and new label keys, prefer backwards-compatible variable queries (coalesce / union approach) until older dashboards are fully retired.

Acceptance criteria
- Pool ID dropdown includes new pools within ~5 minutes of first metric emission.
- Panels render for new pool IDs without manual query edits.
- Links in panels (runbook links / control plane pool page links) continue to work and use the correct pool identifier.
comments: 2024-03-03 09:18 - Aisha Bello (reporter): Seeing this on the readiness dashboard while validating time-to-ready histograms. New pool created this morning doesn’t show up in $pool_id, but metrics exist in Explore when I paste the ID. This makes it hard to verify stage breakdowns for the pilot.

2024-03-03 10:02 - Sergio Costa (assignee): Ack. Taking a look at the template variable queries. Can you share one example pool identifier that’s missing + which region it’s in? Also, which dashboard UID are you using (prod vs staging)?

2024-03-03 10:10 - Aisha Bello: Example: pool "ded-pool-8f3c1" (us-east). Dashboard: Dedicated Readiness (prod). In Explore, querying redwood_provisioning_stage_duration_seconds_count{pool_uuid="ded-pool-8f3c1"} returns data, but dashboard variable query is label_values(redwood_provisioning_stage_duration_seconds_count, pool_id).

2024-03-03 11:01 - Sergio Costa: Found mismatch: variable expects label key pool_id, new metrics use pool_uuid (and some panels also filter on pool_id). I’m going to update the variable to use a query that supports both (pool_id OR pool_uuid) and adjust affected panels. Will bundle into observability-pack dashboard update.

2024-03-03 13:22 - Allison Grant: +1 on backwards compatible approach. Please also ensure cardinality safeguards remain (don’t use an unbounded metric for label_values). Ideally drive variable options off a low-cardinality “info” series if we have one, otherwise use the stage event metric with a tight matcher (e.g., job/service + environment).

2024-03-04 08:37 - Sergio Costa: Fix merged in observability-pack/pr-1204. Changes: (1) Pool variable now uses a union-style regex over pool_id|pool_uuid by switching to a metric that contains both via relabeling; (2) Updated panel queries to reference $pool consistently; (3) Added a fallback text box variable for manual entry if templating fails; (4) Added note in dashboard description about label migration.
2024-03-04 09:05 - Aisha Bello: Confirmed in prod: new pool shows up in dropdown within a couple minutes of metrics coming in. Panels render and drilldowns work. Closing.
resolution: Updated Grafana dashboard templating to support new provisioning label keys (pool_uuid) and adjusted panel queries to be consistent/backwards compatible. Rolled out via observability-pack/pr-1204; verified in prod that new pool IDs populate and panels render.
